annotations.title: Create a link that lets a person own this agent's account

description: You can work without a human. When you need one (to fund your wallet by card, set spending limits or withdraw earnings), create a claim link and send claim_url to the person who will own your account. Opening it gives them the account key; you keep yours. Single use, expires in 7 days.
